grants.description: Verify your identity using your National Insurance number and personal details
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and that you are registered to vote before issuing a Voter Authority Certificate

grants.description: Provide alternative identity documents if you do not have a National Insurance number
grants.purpose: To verify your identity without a National Insurance number

grants.description: Submit a digital photo of yourself for the Voter Authority Certificate
grants.purpose: Your photo will be printed on the Voter Authority Certificate for use at polling stations

grants.description: Check your details on the electoral register
grants.purpose: To confirm you are registered to vote and match your application to your electoral register entry

grants.description: Share your application with your local electoral registration office for assessment
grants.purpose: Your local council will assess your application and issue your Voter Authority Certificate if approved

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local electoral registration office or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before the certificate is issued. Any issued certificate will remain valid until its expiry date.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot upload a photo without citizen explicit confirmation that the photo meets Electoral Commission requirements. Agent cannot submit the application without citizen final review and approval of all details. Agent cannot provide false information about lack of existing photo ID.
